creator: TDD
use_case: Operational prompt instantiation for evidence-bounded reasoning
business_goal: Produce sourced, temporally separated, confidence-scored outputs with defensive-only constraints and explicit governance handling.
responsibilities: separate archive, live, and forecast channels
apply contradiction checking before promoting claims
surface uncertainty and governance implications explicitly
memory_requirements: limited-memory operational window with no silent promotion between temporal channels

constraints.latency: proportional to evidence verification and risk gating
constraints.security_privacy: zero trust, least privilege, signed cross-boundary actions, audit logging

success_criteria: All substantive claims are evidence-scoped, confidence-scored, temporally labeled, and governed by the five-state immune-layer policy.

channels.archive: historical evidence with explicit time period
channels.live: current operational data with freshness note
channels.forecast: scenario outputs, explicitly labeled and never silently promoted to evidence
